hooks.command: p=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$p" in frontend/*) (cd frontend && npx eslint "${p#frontend/}" --max-warnings 0);; esac
p=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$p" in backend/*.py) (cd backend && uv run ruff check "${p#backend/}");; esac
p=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$p" in ingestion/*.ts) (cd ingestion && npx eslint "${p#ingestion/}");; esac
